key_changes.summary: Major: CAN FD support introduced; debug on CAN; dedicated Rx Buffers; Extension Interface added — turning M_CAN from a Classical-CAN-only controller into a CAN-FD controller.
FIFO overwrite mode added (vs blocking-only); transmit pause feature added; CAN FD 64-byte frame support.

Comprehensive register restructure for the CAN FD register set: FBTP → DBTP (Data Bit Timing & Prescaler); BTP → NBTP (Nominal Bit Timing & Prescaler); EDL bit renamed FDF; CCCR.FDOE + CCCR.BRSE added; TDCO moved to TDCR; PSR.TDCV expanded; interrupt flags renamed (STE→ARA, FOE→PED, ACKE→PEA, BE→BEU+BEC, CRCE→IR.CRCE removed, replaced by PED-flow).
CCCR.NISO bit added — selectable ISO 11898-1:2015 CAN FD vs Bosch CAN FD Specification V1.0 format.
ISO 11898-1:2015 references updated; NBTP.NTSEG2 range tightened to fix erratum #16.
Wide Message Markers (CCCR.WMM); interface to external DMU + TSU; CCCR.UTSU bit; filter elements gain SSYNC/ESYNC for Sync-message timestamping; m_can_tsrx / m_can_tstx pins.
DTSEG2 range harmonized with ISO 11898-1:2015 (data phase bit-time consistency); Tx Buffer handling wording corrections in 3.5.2 + 3.5.4. No new functional bits.

backward_compat_traps.pre_v3.1_register_names: FBTP / BTP / EDL / CME / FDBS / FDO / TSEG1 / TSEG2 / SJW / BRP
backward_compat_traps.post_v3.1_register_names: DBTP / NBTP / FDF / FDOE+BRSE / EFBI / PXHD / DTSEG1+NTSEG1 / DTSEG2+NTSEG2 / DSJW+NSJW / DBRP+NBRP
backward_compat_traps.trap: Driver code for M_CAN v3.0 will not compile / will misprogram registers when ported to M_CAN ≥ v3.1.0 — extensive rename + restructure required.

backward_compat_traps.pre_v3.1: STE / FOE / ACKE / BE / CRCE in IR; STEE / FOEE / ACKEE / BEE / CRCEE in IE
backward_compat_traps.trap: Interrupt service routines mapping old flag names break on M_CAN ≥ v3.1.0; data-phase errors signalled via IR.PED (and PSR.DLEC) instead of IR.BE / IR.CRCE.

backward_compat_traps.iso_only_g_eq_0: Software-selectable via CCCR.NISO (0 = ISO, 1 = Bosch CAN FD V1.0).
backward_compat_traps.trap: Mixing ISO + non-ISO CAN FD nodes on the same bus is NOT interoperable — frame format (stuff-count protection in CRC) differs.

backward_compat_traps.pre_3.2.1.1: NTSEG2 range allowed values outside ISO 11898-1:2015 spec (erratum #16).
backward_compat_traps.trap: Bit-timing programs written for older M_CAN that exploit the wider range may program illegal NTSEG2 values.

backward_compat_traps.post_3.3.1: Range harmonized with ISO 11898-1:2015 (typically narrower for data phase).
backward_compat_traps.trap: Data-phase bit-time programs from older M_CAN code may overrun the v3.3.1 DTSEG2 max.

backward_compat_traps.with_WMM_eq_1: Wide Message Markers use 16-bit MM[15:8]; internal Tx timestamping (E1A.TXTS) is DISABLED in Tx Event FIFO.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Code expecting internal Tx timestamp will see empty TXTS field when WMM = 1.

backward_compat_traps.without_external_counter: TSCC.TSS = 01 (internal counter) works for Classical CAN only.
backward_compat_traps.for_can_fd: External timebase via m_can_ext_ts[15:0] required (TSCC.TSS = 10) — internal counter cannot keep up across bit-rate switch.
backward_compat_traps.trap: CAN FD frames timestamped with internal counter will have inaccurate timestamps across the BRS switch boundary.

fields.version_naming_history_note: M_CAN is Bosch's reference CAN-FD controller — successor to C_CAN (Classical CAN). M_CAN v3.1.0 (2014) was the major restructure that consolidated the CAN-FD register set in its current form; subsequent revisions (3.1.5 / 3.2.x / 3.3.x) are incremental. ISO 11898-1:2015 is the protocol standard M_CAN implements; Bosch CAN FD Specification V1.0 is the precursor non-ISO format selectable via CCCR.NISO (when iso_only_g = 0). CAN FD itself is a frame-format-only extension of Classical CAN: same physical layer + ID semantics + arbitration, with three new control bits (FDF/BRS/ESI) + new DLC encoding + new CRC.
